task: Optimize mobile PageSpeed issues reported for https://www.vishomecarpet.com
approvedBy: Site owner request on 2026-08-21 to fix PageSpeed mobile report issues from the provided PageSpeed Insights URL
notes: Existing URLs, content and UI styling are preserved. This change targets mobile PageSpeed issues by deferring non-critical analytics/visitor/cookie/image-protection client bundles until after initial rendering, preloading the mobile LCP hero image, loading carousel slides only when needed, lowering priority for the decorative hero logo mark, and adding long-lived cache headers for stable root static assets such as logos and favicons.
